reviews.review: Its similar to Risk of Rain 2, but with less characters and mobs.  Its similar in pacing in terms of character movements, but its not as hectic as RoR2 because it doesn't shove as many mobs as it can at you like RoR series.  It would be even better if the game had butt loads of characters too, but as it is, it can be enjoyable if you can get into the two available classes.  Haven't tried out the third coz haven't unlocked it.  Though, don't expect it to have as much replayability as RoR series due to a smaller roster.  Consider it a cheaper version of RoR2 lol.

⭐⭐⭐🔵🔵 Arc-Causal-Jogger
Could be much faster, which would also make it much more fun to play. Unfortunately it isn't, so this is about the slowest "Action" game I have in my library. Still, decent time waster.

Update after 9 hours: This jewel has replaced Destiny 2 for me. Yeap, it took me 9 hours to pass through the city into the next level only to die 3 stages later but it was so much fun!! Still playing solo but the progression of your character truly feels on each new run. Hate the bow and snipers though but love my shotgun (as in every other doom like game). I just wish I can start from the next level instead of redoing everything again but that s what make the stakes higher and higher, like in the old arcades you have to start all over again and the stronger you become the more delightful the journey of discovery of the next scenario. Can t believe how good this game is and again how beautiful. Love every second of it.

Ok, let s start by saying this game is beautiful. I love Voxel art and this with all settings to the max rocks! The reflections in the floor the environmental atmosphere, the cyberpunk elements, all is beautiful. Now to the big thing: gunplay... is perfect. I was drawn into this game by it s comparissons to Risk of Rain and eventhough it has it s similarities I feel more vibes of Destiny 2 within than of Risk of Rain. This game is very tactical and hard already in normal difficulty. You have to be very aware of the elements that surround you, both drones and enforcers because each has a reaction time you need to prepare to. Drones are very quick to reach you and eventhough one can t do much damage when you have a bunch around you they can be pretty lethal so you have to remember to activate melee when surrounded or you are done. There are tons of weapons in this game as well as powers and grenades, plus special abilities of the class you choose to play with.

I must confess I haven passed the city yet but I m having such a blast. This game is great solo but I m sure in coop this game rocks so if you have friends suit up and fight together.

Of course as with many of this kind there are almost no player online so bring your friends or ask in the forums. You know a game is good when you want to give a match every day. You know a game is great when you were going to play a match and end up playing 3. This is arcrunner for me. A fantastic game that has all the elements I love from all the genres I play the most and have coop as a bonus.

So as you can see I recommend this game without hesitation. This is a perfect jewel with no battlepass, no micro transactions, a full game that will give you countless hours of fun time.
